summary: Moz2D got correctness and SIMD performance upgrades for image and color handling: CMYK and inverted-CMYK formats were added and fixed, swizzling routines were optimized with SIMD (NEON/SSE/AVX) variants, big-endian packing bugs were fixed, and area computations were widened to 64-bit to avoid overflow. The result is more correct color conversions and faster image processing on a variety of CPUs.
